title: Module 1: Educational Data, FERPA, COPPA, and IDEA
description: Map the three legal frameworks that govern AI deployments in education (FERPA, COPPA, IDEA) and the four ethical concerns the law only partly addresses (surveillance, equity, dark patterns, teacher de-skilling).

learning_objectives.statement: Identify the FERPA, COPPA, and IDEA obligations that apply to a learner-facing AI deployment
Distinguish what is legal under each framework from what is ethical, and name the gap
Recognize four ethical concerns (surveillance, equity, dark patterns, teacher authority) that extend beyond the legal floor
Apply a seven-step pre-deployment workflow to a proposed educational AI system

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
